summary: A weekly unplugged bluegrass circle jam hosted by Pisgah Brewing Company in Black Mountain, Tuesdays at 6pm, moving to the patio in nicer weather. It is a participatory pickers' circle (fiddles, banjos, mandolins, guitars) rather than a sign-up-and-perform open mic, which is the format most likely to sustain a returning core of players who know each other, but no direct evidence (Facebook group, named organizer, membership language) was found confirming a fixed community beyond the venue-run format.

evidence.note: Listing describes an unplugged bluegrass circle jam where players 'bring your instrument to swap tunes at any skill level' and 'trade acoustic breaks and harmonies' - a collaborative jam-circle format, not individual sign-up performances.
All 25 listings are hosted and organized by the venue (Pisgah Brewing Company); no named jam leader, group name, dues, or sign-up link appears in any description.
Tags mix 'Open Mic' with 'Participatory Circle', 'Community Jam', and 'Instrumental Jam', reflecting the ambiguity between a circle jam and an open-mic format.
Explore Asheville's roundup of local bluegrass jams lists this Tuesday jam as 'unplugged, all-levels' but gives no detail on regulars or an organizing community.
No dedicated Facebook group, Meetup page, or independent website for this specific jam turned up in search; only the venue's own event page and aggregator calendar listings.
